summary.title: Managing data science teams
summary.one_liner: Learn practical advice for hiring, retaining, and managing data science teams in the enterprise, including knowledge management and scaling tips.
takeaways: Hire an experienced leader first so junior or academic hires get mentorship and direction.
Choose managers for humility, curiosity, and openness to feedback, not only technical skill; ask about past failures to gauge self-reflection.
Consider replacing onerous take-home tests with a short in-office coding exercise or conversation.
Knowledge management is hard because of rigid classification, weak incentives to document, collective action problems, and tools lagging behind real work.
Scaling covers goals, diagnosis, project and system management, and using a data science platform; two videos give further perspectives.
summary.summary: This Domino Data Lab field guide covers the people side of running data science teams in enterprises. It is organized into sections on hiring and retaining data scientists, habits of successful managers, knowledge management, collaboration, and scaling teams. Hiring advice draws on a panel of data science leaders from ShopRunner and Insight Data Science. The page also links a hiring and onboarding plan template and two videos on building and scaling teams.
